verdict.rationale: The Agents SDK is itself a documented, code-first Python/JS API (Runner, Agent, tools, handoffs, guardrails, tracing, sessions, MCP) explicitly designed for programmatic/agentic use, with extensive public docs and community confirmation of hands-on usage. No formal OpenAPI spec was found, but the SDK's primary interface is the API itself, not a GUI, satisfying the ai-native driving requirement.
